svg.title: The eight chapters around one grammar
svg.desc: Eight chapters on a ring around the grammar, sized by their results (The root 86, The map 94, Knowing and testing 110, Life and evolution 46, Collectives and selection 74, The classical texts 16, Significance and alignment 82, Method and the formal core 21); 497 formal-reuse uses between chapters, 17 pairs with at least 10 drawn; the continuation condition and C come into chapter 7 as premises, each a hypothesis where used, neither asserted; T1 to T8 at their homes, coloured by test outcome.

T1 Persistence certifies the joint draw (02): in the
model proved; beyond the model conjectured, on frozen
tests: of the three settings passed, one of real data;
failed at the instrument's floor (MQ1), after a salt
shock (MQ2 C1), in fish stocks under held catches (MQ3),
in yeast at constant regimes and past the fold; on yeast
values not read before no frozen test of the need or its
fates has passed; no field test of a need measured in
T2 The state of a renewable condition under a draw is
its level, its recent giving and one lag, its place
named before the data (02): conjectured, on four frozen
fish-stock tests; MQ4 failed its whole-state verdict;
MQ5 passed; MQ7 missed its frozen bound; UE31b (run on 6
T3 Optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings,
where that gives room (05): the law for optima proved;
the clause on trained systems conjectured, with partial
support; its second forbidden case proved in expectation
for learners the exchange of the values carries … as
first worded for any condition sharing no units, failing
where the learner reads the condition
T4 The scope can be installed, and it carries (07): IN1
partly passed (with talk, one model of two); transfer
T5 The order is shared by every valuer who counts
everything positively (07): reduction proved under net
weightings; the bound conjectured; valuing positively is
C's premise relocated; VD1: every frozen rule failed;
VD2, sign measured apart: X1s and X2 passed, X1 and X3
failed; role-play judgments, human valuers untested
T6 A break is seen coming only through what couples into
what breaks (03): the invisible half proved on the World
model; the seen half proved in the periphery, in the
linearized and logistic models; one law across domains,
and "only where" beyond these models, conjectured; three
frozen seabird tests did not reject it at their
thresholds; EW2 at low power, estimates in the refuting
T7 A measure read from what it selects outlives its
refutation (02): in the model only invariance under what
the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing
unread coordinate, proved, both without noise; that
actual metrics are so formed conjectured; every frozen
verdict passed and the bridge failed; 02's fourth
forbidden case (a metric whose loss is read only by
those it disfavours, … as worded before its clause on
drift) occurred in this system, counting against that
case as a claim about trained judges
T8 生生 as the direction (07): argued; open: P2 and P4;
